overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: Board members' deliberation during Town Meeting sessions is outside the Law's reach. The AG also reminded the Board of its 14-business-day complaint-response duty, without a violation finding.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Board deliberated outside a noticed meeting during the April 9 and May 10 Town Meeting sessions, when all five members attended.
allegations.key_passage: This deliberation was not a violation of the Open Meeting Law because the Law does not reach any aspect of Town Meeting.

allegations.summary: Not raised by the complainant: the Board apparently did not respond to the first complaint, which was answered only by the Town Manager.
allegations.key_passage: Within 14 business days of receiving a complaint, a public body must review the complaint's allegations; take remedial action, if appropriate; and send to the Attorney General's Office a copy of the complaint and a description of any remedial action taken.
